steps.title: Start with 3 pieces and a board
steps.instruction: Join 3 pieces and a board (A, B, C, D), as the animation shows. Page 5 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: 3 pieces and a board are joined

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the OLIVBLAD furniture. Page 5 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
